home.emptyTitle: Your study overview will live here
home.emptyDescription: Create a deck and add flashcards to it to get started.

dashboard.emptyDescription: Your review history and statistics will appear here once you start reviewing.

settings.languageHint: The language of the app's menus and messages. Your flashcards are not translated.

decks.intro: Open a deck to write its flashcards, or add a new deck at the end.
decks.newDeckFirstHint: A deck holds flashcards in one language and accent. Create your first one to start writing cards.
decks.fixedNote: {{language}} · {{accent}} stays as it is, because the cards in this deck depend on it.
decks.newCardsPerDayHint: Cards seen for the first time. 0 adds none.
decks.maxReviewsPerDayHint: Answers to cards you have recalled before. Cards you are still learning are not limited.

deckEditor.noSavedDescription: Cards you save from New cards appear here, ready to edit.
deckEditor.firstCardDescription: Use the + below to add a card. Your cards stay here as drafts until you save them.

media.videoFailed: The video could not be loaded
media.audioFailed: The audio could not be loaded
media.generateHint: Write the phrase, then generate its audio or attach a file.
media.autoplayBlocked: The audio could not start by itself. Press play to hear it.

review.legend: New cards have not been reviewed yet. Learning cards are still being learned and come back until they are recalled. Review cards are due to be reviewed.
review.noDecksDescription: Reviews are built from the flashcards in your decks. Create a deck and add some cards first.
review.noCardsTitle: Your decks have no flashcards yet
review.noCardsDescription: Add flashcards to a deck and it will be ready to review here.
review.noFlashcards: No flashcards yet. <add>Add some</add> to review them here.
review.nextCard: The next card comes back in {{interval}}.
review.noneScheduled: No more cards are scheduled. New ones appear when you add them.
review.dailyLimitReached: This deck's daily limit has been reached. The rest of its cards come back in {{interval}}.
review.reloadFailed: Your answer was saved, but the next card could not be loaded.
review.dictationHint: Alt+R plays the audio again, Alt+Space shows the answer

savedList.noMatch: No saved card matches this search.
savedList.expandAria: Show the cards of this stack
savedList.collapseAria: Hide the cards of this stack

panel.title: Edit flashcard
panel.saved: Changes saved. The review history of this card is kept.

errors.tauriUnavailable: Tauri is not available here. Run the app with `npm run tauri dev`.

stack.sharedHint: Shared by the cards of this stack. Each card can have its own.
stack.linkedAria: Phrase linked to the stack. Press to give this card its own phrase.
stack.unlinkedAria: This card has its own phrase. Press to link it to the stack.
stack.takeOutAria: Take this card out of the stack
stack.deleteAria: Delete the stack and all of its cards
stack.confirmDeleteAria: Confirm deleting the stack and all of its cards

dictionary.title: Pronunciation dictionary
dictionary.intro: Pronunciations (IPA) come from the ipa-dict word lists, which are not part of the app. Import their folder once and it stays on this computer.
dictionary.importingHint: Reading about 2.5 million words. This can take a minute.
dictionary.empty: Nothing is installed yet, so the pronunciation buttons will say the dictionary is missing.
dictionary.licenseNote: The word lists have different licenses. Read the notes in docs/development.md before sharing the app.
